description: This is a migration script for the Superset project, specifically handling database schema updates related to x-axis sorting in time series charts. It modifies chart parameters stored in the database during upgrade and downgrade operations.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a chart slice with id, params, and viz_type fields.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Updates chart parameters to replace 'x_axis_sort_series' with 'x_axis_sort' and 'x_axis_sort_series_ascending' with 'x_axis_sort_asc' for relevant time series charts.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the parameter changes made in upgrade, replacing 'x_axis_sort' with 'x_axis_sort_series' and 'x_axis_sort_asc' with 'x_axis_sort_series_ascending'.
